finish_summary:
bulk_discount_percent: for quantity >=50 it should return 10 but implementation returns 5 at quantity == 50.
parse_coupon: the function is case-sensitive, but spec requires case-insensitive matching of the prefix "SAVE".
Cart.remove_item: removes an item only when remaining quantity <0; spec says should remove when <=0.
Cart.total: shipping_fee is computed on the original subtotal instead of the discounted amount after applying a coupon, violating spec that shipping fee must be based on the post-coupon amount.
